messages:
Aisha (CEO): Quick heads-up — all-hands tomorrow 10:00am PT. I want to keep this lean and action-oriented. Please drop one-line Qs in this thread or reply "raise" if you want a 2-min live slot. :sparkles:
Priya (Product): Agenda please?
Aisha (CEO): Agenda: 1) Product highlights (3m), 2) Marco: rollout schedule for v2 inference (3m), 3) Dedicated capacity / SLA update (5m), 4) Ops incident recap + learnings (5m), 5) Q&A and shoutouts, 6) Next steps. Keep presenters to time.
Marco (VP Eng): Can add a short rollout slide for v2 inference and quick notes on compatibility with quantized variants.
Sam (People Ops): Logistics: Zoom 10:00-11:00 PT — link: https://zoom.redwood.com/allhands. Live captions enabled. Recording will be posted to #all-hands-recordings within ~2 hours after the meeting.
Dan (SRE): Quick incident note to mention during the Ops recap: we had a degraded tail latency window for ~22m last week. Failover worked; root cause was a cache-config sync issue between control plane and runtime. Follow-up doc will be on Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/incidents/1757 — action: add end-to-end cache sync test and an alert for config drift.
Elena (Marketing): Also planning a 2-min highlight clip post-meeting for partners. If your team wants a 15s on-camera bit, reply here.
Priya (Product): Qs collection plan: drop one-sentence Qs here. We'll bucket into product / infra / security and surface the most upvoted in the live Q&A.
Alex (Engineer): Q: will the dedicated SLA changes affect billing/pricing for existing committed pools?
Marco (VP Eng): Short answer for tomorrow's slide: the SLA updates adjust billing cadence for committed capacity and add a new latency tier. We'll link the pricing FAQ and the migration guide.
Aisha (CEO): Policy heads-up: starting next week, new PRD requirement — attach a short eval plan for any model change that affects generated output. Full policy note will be posted to #product-policies after the all-hands.
Aisha (CEO): If you want to speak live, reply "raise" and I'll slot you. Otherwise drop Qs and we'll pull them into the curated Q&A.
replay-bot: Recording posted: https://records.redwood.com/allhands/1758000000.mp4
Sam (People Ops): Post-meeting: I'll post meeting notes, action items, and owners in this thread and update the handbook summary. Please add owners inline if you take an action.
Aisha (CEO): Quick takeaways to leave with: 1) expect a small SLA update next week, 2) SRE to add end-to-end cache sync test and alert, 3) Product teams to attach eval plans to PRDs going forward. Thanks all — see you tomorrow. :raised_hands:
